πῆχυς.long: a cubit, about a foot and a half.
πῆχυς.sd: the fore-arm, i.e. (as a measure) a cubit
πῆχυς.as:
πῆχυς, -εως, gen. pl., -ῶν (for Att. -εων, v. WH, App., 157; Thackeray, Gr., 151; Deiss., BS, 153),
[in LXX chiefly and freq. for אַמָּה;]
1.the forearm (Hom.).
2. As a measure of length, a cubit: Mt 6:27, Lk 12:25, Jo 21:8, Re 21:17.†

πήρα.long: a sack, wallet for carrying provisions.
πήρα.sd: a wallet or leather pouch for food
πήρα.as:
** πήρα, -ας, ἡ,
[in LXX: Jth 10:513:10, 15*;]
a leathern pouch for victuals, etc., a wallet (Deiss. thinks an alms-bag, v. LAE, 108 ff.): Mt 10:10, Mk 6:8, Lk 9:310:422:35, 36.†

πηγή.long: a fountain, spring, well, issue, flow.
πηγή.sd: a fount (literally or figuratively), i.e. source or supply (of water, blood, enjoyment) (not necessarily the original spring)
πηγή.der: probably from G4078 (πήγνυμι) (through the idea of gushing plumply);
πηγή.as:
πηγή, -ῆς, ἡ,
[in LXX chiefly for עַיִן, also for מָקוֹר, etc.;]
a spring, fountain: Ja 3:11, II Pe 2:17; τ. ὑδάτων, Re 8:1014:716:4; of a well fed by a spring, Jo 4:6; π. τοῦ αἵματος, of a flow of blood, Mk 5:29; metaph., Jo 4:14, Re 7:1721:6.†

πήγανον.g: rue, a plant used for flavoring food
πήγανον.long: rue, a plant used for flavoring or garnishing food.
πήγανον.sd: rue (from its thick or fleshy leaves)

πηλός.as:
πηλός, οῦ, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for חֹמֶר, טִיט;]
1.clay, as used by a potter: Ro 9:21 (cf. Is 29:16, al.).
2. = βόρβορος, wet clay, mud: Jo 9:6, 11, 14, 15.†

πηδάλιον.sd: from the same as G3976 (πέδη)); a "pedal", i.e. helm
πηδάλιον.der: neuter of a (presumed) derivative of (the blade of an oar;
πηδάλιον.as:
* πηδάλιον, -ου, τό
(< πηδός, the blade of an oar),
a rudder: Ja 3:4; pl., Ac 27:40.†

πηλίκος.sd: how much (as an indefinite), i.e. in size or (figuratively) dignity
πηλίκος.der: a quantitative form (the feminine) of the base of G4225 (πού);
πηλίκος.as:
πηλίκος, -η, -ον,
[in LXX: Za 2:2 (6) (כַּמָּה), IV Mac 15:22*;]
interrog., how large, how great? (prop., of magnitude, as πόσος of quantity): in exclamations, = ἡλίκος (v. Bl., § 51, 4), Ga 6:11; of personal greatness, He 7:4.†

πήγνυμι.sd: to fix ("peg"), i.e. (specially) to set up (a tent)
πήγνυμι.der: a prolonged form of a primary verb (which in its simpler form occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses);
πήγνυμι.as:
πήγνυμι,
[in LXX chiefly for נטה, also for תּקע, etc.;]
to make fast, to fix; of tents, to pitch: He 8:2 (cf. προσ-πήγνυμι).†
